welcome.title: Know what to plant next
welcome.subtitle: A simple rotation plan for your plot, using rain and soil moisture data for your area.
welcome.intro: Answer three short questions. Get a plan for the next seasons with a reason for each crop.
welcome.noAccountNeeded: You do not need an account to try. We do not store personal details unless you sign in.
welcome.stepLocationBody: Use your location or pick your district and sub-county.
welcome.stepClimateBody: Rain, moisture and the chance of a dry spell.
welcome.stepPlanBody: Crops for the next seasons, with reasons and warnings.
welcome.demoNote: Some data in this demo is sample data and is labelled on screen.
welcome.trust: Built with NASA Earth observation data and reviewed agronomy rules.

location.title: Where is your plot?
location.subtitle: We use your area to read the nearest climate data. This is regional guidance, not a measurement of your field.
location.gpsDenied: Location permission was denied. Choose your district and sub-county instead.
location.gpsUnsupported: This device cannot share a location. Choose your district and sub-county instead.
location.gpsOutside: Your location is outside the supported area. Choose a district in Lango.
location.manualHint: If you know the latitude and longitude of your plot, enter them here.
location.orChoose: Or choose your district and sub-county
location.outOfRegion: This location is outside the area NextCrop supports.
location.outOfRegionBody: NextCrop currently covers the Lango sub-region. Choose a district in Lango or move the pin.
location.mapLabel: Map of the Lango sub-region. Tap the map to place your pin.
location.mapHelp: Tap the map to place a pin. You can also use the district lists below.
location.lowData: Map tiles are hidden in low-data mode. Use the district lists.
location.mapUnavailable: The map could not load. Use the district lists below.
location.coordinatesInvalid: Enter a valid latitude and longitude, for example 2.25 and 32.90.

climate.title: Season context for your area
climate.subtitle: What the latest rain and soil moisture data say about your area. This is not a measurement of your field.
climate.moistureHint: Compared with the usual for your area at this time of year.
climate.onsetHintDetected: Steady rain has started in your area.
climate.onsetHintNotStarted: The season has not started in your area yet.
climate.onsetHintFalseStart: Rain started but a dry spell may follow. Wait for steady rain.
climate.onsetHintUnknown: We do not have enough recent rain data to judge the start of the season.
climate.drySpellDaysValue: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without rain
climate.drySpellsCountValue: {count, plural, one {# dry spell} other {# dry spells}}
climate.dataLimits: What this can and cannot tell you
climate.dataLimitsBody: Satellite data is coarse. It can tell you about rain and moisture across your area. It cannot measure your soil, your plot or your crop. Use it together with what you see on the ground and advice from your extension officer.
climate.noDataBody: We could not get recent data for your area. We assume normal conditions and still give you a safe plan. Check the sky and ask your extension officer.
climate.staleBody: The newest data for your area is {hours} hours old. Treat the season context as a general guide.
climate.chartSummary: Rain chart: {actual} mm this year against a usual {normal} mm over 30 days.
climate.chartTable: Show rain data as a table
climate.rainfallAria: Bar chart of daily rain for the last 30 days compared with the usual.
climate.gaugeAria: Soil moisture gauge showing {class}. The scale runs from dry to wet.
climate.bannerBody: The data describes your area, not your field. Your soil and slope can differ.
climate.fetchError: We could not load the season context.
climate.sampleBody: The R0 hackathon demo uses a deterministic sample dataset for Lango. The label is shown so the demo never looks like a live forecast.

wizard.title: Three short questions
wizard.subtitle: We use your answers with the season context for your area.
wizard.previousCropTitle: What did you grow last season?
wizard.previousCropHint: Choose the crop that was on this plot most recently.
wizard.secondCropTitle: What did you grow before that?
wizard.secondCropHint: This is optional. It helps us avoid repeating a crop too soon.
wizard.noSecondCrop: I do not remember, or this is a new plot
wizard.soilHint: Choose the closest answer. If you are not sure, choose Not sure.
wizard.soilUnknownHint: We will use a cautious plan
wizard.goalHint: Choose the one that matters most this season.
wizard.goalRestoreHint: Feed the soil and break pest cycles
wizard.goalCashHint: Choose crops with good market demand
wizard.goalDroughtHint: Choose crops that tolerate less rain
wizard.flagsHint: Optional. These warnings change the plan.
wizard.seasonsHint: The default plan covers four seasons.
wizard.reviewHint: You can change any answer before getting the plan.
wizard.requiredCrop: Choose the crop you grew last season.
wizard.offlineNotice: You are offline. Your answers will be saved and sent when you reconnect.
wizard.queuedTitle: Your answers are waiting to send
wizard.queuedBody: We saved your answers on this phone. The plan will arrive as soon as you are back online.
wizard.queuedHint: Keep this page open, or come back later. Nothing is lost.
wizard.whatIfHint: Change one answer and run the plan again.
wizard.flagsSelected: {count, plural, one {# warning selected} other {# warnings selected}}
wizard.queuedReady: Your plan is ready. Open it from the start page.

plan.title: Your rotation plan
plan.subtitle: A plan for the next {count, plural, one {# season} other {# seasons}} for your area.
plan.fallbackBody: The rules could not find a usual crop for this season. We chose a safe legume or cover crop. Ask your extension officer before planting a different crop.
plan.lockedBody: Cassava stays on this plot for at least two seasons. There is no rotation inside this block.
plan.disclaimerBody: This plan uses regional climate data and agronomy rules. It does not measure your field. Check with your extension officer before planting.
plan.whatIfTitle: Try a different goal or warning
plan.whatIfBody: Change one thing to see how the plan changes. Your saved plan stays the same.
plan.printHint: Use your browser print option and choose Save as PDF.
plan.samplePlanBody: The demo rule pack and sample engine produced this plan. The production API returns the same contract.
plan.noPlanBody: Answer three short questions to get your first plan.
plan.emptyAlternatives: No alternative crops passed the rules for this season.
plan.warningWetGroundnut: Groundnut does not like waterlogged soil. Check drainage.
plan.warningWetBean: Bean is sensitive to waterlogging. Plant on raised ridges.
plan.warningArmyworm: Fall armyworm pressure lowers maize. Scout fields early.
plan.warningLowFertility: Soil fertility is low. A legume first helps the next cereal.
plan.warningCassavaDisease: Cassava disease was reported. Use clean planting material only.
plan.warningFallback: No usual crop passed every rule. This safe fallback keeps the soil covered.
plan.warningStriga: Striga is present. Avoid cereals and prefer cowpea or soya to reduce the seed bank.
plan.warningGroundnutDisease: Groundnut disease history. Groundnut is excluded for two seasons.
plan.warningNoRecentData: No recent climate data. We assumed normal conditions.
plan.warningDryMaize: The season is dry. Maize is not recommended.
plan.warningLocks: Cassava block: two seasons, no rotation inside.
plan.rationaleLegumeAfterMaize: Legumes feed your soil after maize and break pest cycles.
plan.rationaleCerealAfterLegume: A cereal after a legume uses the nitrogen the legume left behind.
plan.rationaleCashCrop: This crop has good market demand for your area and fits the season.
plan.rationaleDroughtCrop: This crop tolerates dry spells better than most crops.
plan.rationaleRotateFamily: A different crop family breaks pest and disease cycles.
plan.rationaleSafeFallback: A safe legume or cover crop protects the soil when other crops fail the rules.
plan.rationaleCassavaBlock: Cassava is a long block of two seasons, so the plot stays under cassava.
plan.rationaleSeasonFit: This crop suits the season and the moisture expected in your area.
plan.rationaleStriga: This crop helps reduce striga in the soil.
plan.offlineSaved: Saved on this phone for offline reading.
plan.loadError: We could not load this plan.
plan.traceNote: Every plan keeps its rule pack version and the rules that produced it.
plan.intercroppingNote: You could plant {crop} with this crop. Ask your extension officer for spacing advice.
plan.feedbackPrompt: Did this plan help? Tell us what you planted.
plan.goToPlotsHint: Sign in to save this plot and find the plan later.

plots.title: My plots and history
plots.subtitle: Save up to five plots and find your past plans.
plots.emptyBody: Save a plot after getting a plan, or add one now.
plots.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Past plans will stay in your history.
plots.limitBody: Delete a plot before adding another. Five is the current limit.
plots.noHistory: No past plans for this plot yet.
plots.usePlotHint: This fills in location, soil and last crop.
plots.signInBody: Your plots stay on your account. You need a phone number to sign in.
plots.locationRequired: Choose a location for this plot.
plots.sizeInvalid: Enter a size between 0.1 and 100 acres.
plots.offlineSave: You are offline. Plot saving needs a connection.
plots.loadError: We could not load your plots.
plots.historyLoadError: We could not load your past plans.

feedback.title: Tell us about your season
feedback.subtitle: Your answer helps us improve the advice for everyone.
feedback.ratingTitle: How did it go compared with a usual season?
feedback.commentPlaceholder: Optional. Do not include personal details.
feedback.submittedBody: Your feedback is linked to the rules that gave the advice. It helps the agronomist improve the plan.
feedback.offlineQueued: You are offline. Your feedback is saved and will send when you reconnect.
feedback.thanksBody: Feedback from farmers like you makes the next plan better.
feedback.queuedSent: Your saved feedback has been sent. Thank you.

auth.signInIntro: We send a six-digit code by SMS. There is no password to remember.
auth.phoneHint: Use the number that receives SMS, for example 0770 000 000.
auth.codeIntro: We sent a code to {phone}. It expires in five minutes.
auth.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Check the message and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts or messages. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
auth.rateLimitedBody: For safety, we limit how often a code can be sent.
auth.anonymousBody: You can get a plan without an account. We do not store personal details.
auth.signOutBody: You can still read your last plan on this phone.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
auth.notAuthorizedBody: Sign in with an extension officer or admin account to continue.
auth.consentNeeded: Please accept the consent notice before continuing.
auth.otpPrivacy: We only use your number to sign you in and send the messages you ask for.
auth.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with at least 9 digits.
auth.signUpIntro: Sign up with your phone number. We send a one-time code by SMS.
auth.nameInvalid: Enter your name to create an account.
auth.rolePanelHeading: Sign in once. Land in your own area.
auth.rolePanelBody: Every user signs in with a phone number and a one-time code. The system opens only the workspace allowed for that account.
auth.farmerAccessBody: See your plots, plans, season outlook and advice for your own farm.
auth.extensionAccessBody: Work only in the sub-counties assigned to you: register farmers, record observations and send advice.
auth.adminAccessBody: Full platform access: users, rule packs, reports, audit trail and every workspace.
auth.staffProvisionedNote: Extension worker and admin accounts are created by the NextCrop administrator.
auth.farmerSignupNote: New public sign-ups create farmer accounts only.
auth.selectRoleHint: Pick how you use NextCrop. You will be taken straight to that workspace.
auth.staffSignupNote: Extension and admin sign-up only works for accounts already provisioned by the administrator. To request access, contact NextCrop.

consent.title: Your choices and your data
consent.intro: Before we store anything about you, we ask for your consent. You can change your mind later.
consent.purposeTitle: What we use your data for
consent.purposeBody: We use your phone number to sign you in and send advice. We use your plots and answers to build your rotation plan. We use feedback to improve the rules.
consent.sharingBody: We do not sell your data. We only share anonymised totals, never your phone number or your plot.
consent.withdrawBody: Withdrawing consent stops messages. It does not delete your past plans.
consent.declined: You can still get a plan without an account. Nothing is saved about you.

dataRights.title: Your data
dataRights.intro: You can see, correct or delete the data linked to your account.
dataRights.deleteBody: This removes your account, plots and plans. It cannot be undone. Anonymised totals stay in reports.
dataRights.consentsCount: {count, plural, one {# consent record} other {# consent records}}
dataRights.contactOfficer: You can also ask your extension officer for help.
dataRights.retentionBody: Plans linked to you are kept for 24 months. Message logs are kept for 12 months. Consent records are kept for the life of the account plus three years.
dataRights.authRequired: Sign in to see or delete your data.
dataRights.correctHint: To correct your phone number, sign in again with the new number or contact support.
dataRights.deletedBody: Your personal data is removed. Thank you for using NextCrop.

dashboard.addPlotIntro: Keep your field details and plans together.

dashboard.extensionIntro: Welcome, {name}. This is your field site. You only see the sub-counties assigned to you.
dashboard.areaOverviewIntro: Live reach and season signals for each area in your scope.
dashboard.noAssignedAreasBody: Ask an administrator to assign your sub-counties before you register farmers.

dashboard.fullAccessHint: As administrator you can open every workspace and control.

dashboard.auditIntro: See a complete record of administrative actions.
